description: A notify configuration defines the settings used to send templated messages with AWS End User Messaging SMS managed messaging, including the display name, use case, enabled channels, and enabled countries.

NotifyConfigurationArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the notify configuration.

NotifyConfigurationId.description: The unique identifier for the notify configuration.

DisplayName.description: The display name to associate with the notify configuration.

UseCase.description: The use case for the notify configuration.

DefaultTemplateId.description: The default template identifier to associate with the notify configuration. If specified, this template is used when sending messages without an explicit template identifier.

PoolId.description: The identifier of the pool to associate with the notify configuration.

EnabledCountries.description: An array of two-character ISO country codes, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format, that are enabled for the notify configuration.

EnabledChannels.description: An array of channels to enable for the notify configuration. Supported values include SMS and VOICE.

DeletionProtectionEnabled.description: By default this is set to false. When set to true the notify configuration can't be deleted.

Tier.description: The tier of the notify configuration.

TierUpgradeStatus.description: The tier upgrade status of the notify configuration.

Status.description: The current status of the notify configuration.

CreatedTimestamp.description: The time when the notify configuration was created.

Tags.description: An array of tags (key and value pairs) associated with the notify configuration.

Key.description: The key identifier, or name, of the tag.

Value.description: The string value associated with the key of the tag.
